description: Returns the plans of MyDataHub by Emailmovers, the UK B2B count engine: credit packs, credit rules, licence terms, the bounce warranty and the free trial, in GBP, plus VAT. Use it when the user asks what a list costs or which plan fits; it is free and needs no account. One credit buys one complete UK record at the same price in the app, the API and here. Call get_account for the caller's own balance, or count_audience to size a list. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.
